english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when a person or thing moves around in circles.
Use this colloquial expression when someone or something moves around a target or goes round repeatedly.

examples.english: The bus continued to circulate around the roundabout.
examples.traditional: 架巴士喺個迴旋處兜圈。
examples.jyutping: gaa3 baa1 si2 hai2 go3 wui4 syun4 cyu3 dau1 hyun1

examples.english: The bus keeps going in a circle around the city centre.
examples.jyutping: gaa3 baa1 si2 hai2 si5 zung1 sam1 dau1 hyun1
